visualCharacteristics.purpose: Top-of-page marquee: eyebrow, title and body copy beside a full-bleed image
visualCharacteristics.description: Light grey left half with eyebrow, large title and body text; full-bleed image on the right half

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = media: an image, optionally followed by a paragraph holding a link to an .mp4 file (ambient video; the image is its poster/fallback); row 2 = eyebrow (H1), title (H2) and body paragraph(s). Rows may be in either order; the media row is optional (adds no-image)

H1 eyebrow 'Content Supply Chain – Asset Management'; H2 'Maximize your content's value with agentic AI.'; paragraph body copy

usage.description: Use for the opening marquee of solution/product pages with text on one half and an image on the other.

reuseGuidance: Reuse for any split hero; use the base hero for text over a background image.
